author: Kairos I
title: Watcher: Run Novelty if Normalized Exists
abstract: Checks for normalized JSONL in progressor storage and runs the shared novelty stub if present; otherwise prints a waiting message.

original_submission.content:
import os, sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

norm_path = 'storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs/all_transgen_logs.normalized.jsonl'
out_path  = 'storage/shared/progressor_outputs/novelty_scores.jsonl'

if os.path.exists(norm_path):
    from progressor_tools.novelty_stub import run
    print("NOVELTY_WATCHER: normalized file found -> running novelty stub.")
    run(in_path=norm_path, out_path=out_path)
else:
    print("NOVELTY_WATCHER: normalized file not found; will retry next tick if needed.")
